issues.description: Field 'animals' in class Farm: the problem statement (problem_statement.md lines 108-111) explicitly requires the Farm to use a List implemented as an ArrayList and to initialize that ArrayList in the no-argument constructor. The reference solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java lines 9-13) instead declares the field as 'private Queue<Animal> animals' and initializes it with 'new LinkedList<>()'. This type mismatch (List/ArrayList vs Queue/LinkedList) can confuse students about the expected collection type and the required getter/setter signatures and may lead to test or autograder failures if the tests expect List-specific behavior or signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent with the problem statement. Preferred fix: change the solution to declare the field as 'private List<Animal> animals;' and initialize it in the no-argument constructor with 'this.animals = new ArrayList<>();' and adapt the getter/setter signatures to use List<Animal>. Alternatively, if Queue semantics were intended, update the problem statement and UML to permit a generic Collection/Queue implementation and adjust the textual requirement so students aren't required to use ArrayList.
